title: groot
summary: Return the root graphics object handle.

gpu_support.notes: `groot` reads and updates host-side graphics state only. It does not execute numeric GPU kernels.

description: `groot` returns the MATLAB-compatible root graphics object handle, numeric handle `0`. Root properties expose global plotting state such as the current figure, open figure children, screen metadata, units, and show-hidden-handles mode.
behaviors: `get(groot, 'CurrentFigure')` returns the current figure handle, or an empty handle array when no figure exists.
`get(groot, 'Children')` returns currently open figure handles in stable ascending order.
`set(groot, 'CurrentFigure', fig)` selects an existing figure as current.
`set(groot, 'default...', value)` stores arbitrary root default properties for compatibility with scripts that configure graphics defaults.

examples.description: Select a current figure through the root object
Round-trip a root default graphics property

faqs.question: Is `groot` the same value as MATLAB's root object?
faqs.answer: Yes. RunMat uses numeric handle `0` for the root graphics object.

faqs.question: Does setting root defaults restyle all future graphics objects?
faqs.answer: RunMat stores and returns common scalar, text, string-array, and numeric-array `default...` root properties for compatibility. Full automatic application of every MATLAB root default is handled incrementally as each graphics property area is implemented.

faqs.question: Does `groot` gather GPU arrays?
faqs.answer: No. It only touches graphics metadata and global plotting state.

gpu_residency: `groot` returns a host-side numeric graphics handle and does not interact with GPU residency.
gpu_behavior: `groot` performs no provider dispatch; it reads or updates root plotting metadata in the runtime registry.
